what: current BDT sales price in the online shop (medusa.utilitymart.shop) of every variant that is a 100001 (HMBR) or 100000 (GI) item
use: onetime/set_xsrate_from_json.py writes price into caitem.xsrate where zid and xitem match; xitem is the shop SKU
rules: price = the shop's current BDT price
if the shop price is below the std price (xstdprice) of the source item, price = floor(xstdprice x 1.35) and the entry says so (basis)

2026-11-03: the same rule was applied by hand to 01250, 1866, 2060 and 2182 (HMBR) using the std prices on the live server; the Mac copy of the database had lower std prices for them, so the generator had not caught them
